rationale: The raw filing reports GCOM fair value of $17.155 million and percentage of net assets of 10.07%, while the statement of assets and liabilities reports current-period net assets of $170.267 million. Dividing the displayed fair value by the NAV gives 10.0754%. The marginal identity residual is therefore caused by precision and rounding of the displayed source amounts; both extracted fields match the raw source, so the identity flag is a false alarm rather than a data error.
